## 🎯 Questions by Difficulty Level

### Entry-Level (Recommended: 40 questions)
- All questions from: Introduction, iOS Basics, Swift Programming
- Q1-Q3 from each remaining topic

### Mid-Level (Recommended: 70 questions)
- All entry-level questions
- Q4-Q5 from each topic
- Focus on: Architecture, Networking, Concurrency

### Senior-Level (Recommended: 100+ questions)
- All questions
- Deep dive on advanced topics
- Be able to expand with examples from experience
